author: minutephysics
description:
Sign up to get started with Brilliant for free here: https://brilliant.org/minutephysics. You'll also save 20% off an annual subscription.

We used to think our eyes could see things using something called "visual fire". This short film explains how we managed to move away from this theory and come to understand how our sight really works. Made in collaboration with MinuteEarth and Derek of Veritasium, and originally released in 2018.

MinuteEarth's Channel: https://youtube.com/@minuteearth
Veritasium's Channel: https://www.youtube.com/veritasium

Link to Patreon Supporters: http://www.minutephysics.com/supporters/
And Facebook: http://facebook.com/minutephysics

Minute Physics provides an energetic and entertaining view of old and new problems in physics -- all in a minute!

Created by Henry Reich
Produced by Joshua Chawner

00:00 Intro
00:12 Balor's Poisonous Eye
01:14 Paradigms
02:12 Plato: The Eye Emits "Visual Fire"
04:02 Problems & Progress 
05:33 Ibn al-Haytham: The Eye Sees Li
title: We Used To Think Light Came From Our Eyes!?
